query: What do Samsung Galaxy S8 Plus owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?
search_text: What do owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?

rows.text: The phone is not as impressive as advertised. The .... The phone is not as impressive as advertised. The camera picture quality is very low when using the zoom function. It tremendously blurs the images. The phone slows down a lot as soon as I installed a couple of apps on it.

I love how the GS8 comes with standard 64 GB of memory and also includes the ability to add more, unlike apple. Great option and I have more memory available after moving all my stuff from my old phone over than my GS7 came with, now that's nice. I have an expansion card, but I doubt I'll need it, but you never know. It's nice to have either way. The cameras are great. Where they truly shine is not only are they great front and back, but both have f1.7 aperture. So they absolutely are stellar at taking low-light photos, yes, even better than the iPhone 7 (if only slightly so). I think bumping up the front camera to 8MP was a smart move. With the popularity of selfies not slowing down, it was a wise precaution.

Great smartphone. Very good smartphone. It was considered by many sites as the best smartphone of 2017. And it meets the expectations: top class display, good battery, great camera in low light, memory card, water resistant, ... Even the hindrance of the fingerprint sensor may not be in the most ideal location is not as bad as I thought. A case with accurate cutouts will give the fingerprint sensor some physical separation. And after a while we get used to the position of the sensor. The only negative is the camera tends to prettyfying the pictures with an aggressive image over-processing. But this a problem with most if not all Samsung phones and other brands as well.

S8 camera focus issue. The phone is okay. There is a intermittend but constant issue with the fact with the rear camera though. It fails to focus several times per day. I went through all the updates processes, cleaned the lens and did several fault finding exercises. Eventually after consultation with a tecnical support person from Samsung, he weirdly suggested I give the phone a good shake. Hesintantly I did that, and the camera miraculously focused again. I was advice that the camera is sticking and on it's way out and eventually will fail permanently Very disappointed. I only have the phone a week. But its bought via Amazon as used item and it's my problem I suppose. I can't help but wondering if the seller was probably aware of this issue, hence the selling of the phone.
You get what you pay for.. My front camera is broken. I can't do iris or face recognition for my security lock. Other than that, my phone is in great shape and works well.

Amazon says T-Mobile, phone says Verizon. Came in early which was awesome. After reading the reviews I called T-Mobile and did a quick internet check to double check the IMEI to make sure this wasn’t a stolen device. The device checks out so far. I have not put a SIM card in to set it up. The reason the rating is so low is because this says T-Mobile on Amazon but when I turned the phone on it said to connect to my Verizon network. The phone is basically a Verizon S8 phone, but the phone should be a T-Mobile S8+ phone. Huge difference. I try contacting BREED and they will not give me a darn link to send them the photos of the wrong phone. It has been 3 weeks and still no solution If there’s no issues with it and it works great, I’ll consider changing my review to more stars.

Quality phone for the price. Love this phone, the camera is really nice takes great photos, the sound quality is is absolutely fantastic for movies and listening to music, charges pretty quick, holds a long charge

I got mine in the Arctic Silver and wish that I could actually see it, but I have to keep that casing on it! I know that some people wanted the smoother outer design, but I'd much rather that it were pebbled - or at least along the edges. I bet half the time the phone gets damaged will not be from carelessness but from the phone just sliding out of people's hands. So, to sum up, the PROs: - Phone is gorgeously styled and the color choices are nice. I really like the Arctic Silver which is stylish and still professional/adult looking. - Camera is *amazing*. Photos turn out awesome and the easy-flip to selfie feature is nice. - Volume control is better.
Samsung S8 plus. Very happy about my phone, as described, works very good I love the camera

A class Act. S8+ is everything for which I was hoping. Slim, bright and nice features. I enjoy face-recognition to unlock. Poisition of fingerprint reader sucks - right next to the camera lens. Overall - a class act.

Best Phone Samsung Ever Made. I got my phone from Verizon in 2017. I've been using it since, with no complaints. I've mistakenly dropped it multiple times ( I have good quality covers) and it's still going strong... I'm not suggesting you deliberately dropp yours smile I multi task while on a call ( text, email, take pictures - anything - at the same time, I'm talking on the phone. I've run through a VERY LIGHT drizzle (rain), with it, and my Samsung was still functioning perfectly. Picture quality is very good. Buy this phone with confidence.

Decent low light images as well *USB-C - Samsung has done well at this, including 2 adapters (USB-C to USB and Micro-usb to USB-c) *Bixby - It will be nice to have a nice SIRI alternative Cons *Internal speaker is on bottom of phone, and I seem to accidentally cover it a lot *Infinity display gets touched often, because it is all the way to the edges *No home, back, or task button - these are now softkeys, which i don't like as well *Bixby not fully functional on release date - they could have given old s-voice as an alternative until Bixby is finished Overall, I would recommend this phone

More bad than good.. Purchased 3 weeks before pre-order. I've had it since it was released, so I have 2 months experience battling with this phone. I'll start with the few good things I have to say. I love the screen resolution and clarity. I love the camera, especially shooting video in 60FPS. Its also very responsive and quick, and the battery lasts forever. And that's all I have to say about that... The bad- No screen protector works. I've never cracked a screen on a phone. Ever. I've went through 5 screen protectors in 2 months trying to protect this $800+ investment. The screen is horrible in design, and makes protecting it impossible, and makes cracking extremely easy. A 2 year payment plan is just stupid on this device, because it will never last that long without breaking.

Pretty good phone, some other reviews say its fragile....get a phone case. Easy to transfer data, Light weight... Face recognition seems to use more battery, Fingerprint reader is too close to camera lens... Overall a good phone and I like it well.
Awesome phone. I love this phone! It's light weight and feels comfortable in your hand because it's not wide. The screen and camera are so nice and clear.
